headline: Abşeron district offers wide grocery access with low road paving rates.

summary: Abşeron has a population of 435,200 across 2,010.9 km² with a density of 206 people per km². The neighbourhood provides 17.33 groceries and 8.48 food spots per 10,000 residents. Transport connectivity relies on 3 rail stations and 118 bus stops. Paved roads account for 13.4% of known surfaces, while OSM coverage is high.
